coordinate_policy: Canonical world chart sets initial Body 1 local x azimuth to world x. Reference and JT initialization use one gravity-axis rotation G around fixed support; STEP chart is measurement-defined. No per-body or trajectory-fitted alignment.
noise_and_bias: See configs/measurement_errors.json; both methods read the same measurement files, without correction by the true biases.
jt_initialization: true initial position velocity and attitude in canonical chart; perturbed initial lever vectors
jt_updates: one EKF update; repeated nonlinear updates without an IEKF prior correction are forbidden
step_method: Stage I calibration; Stage II with midpoint specific-force propagation (all bodies) and the heading-consistent (OC-EKF) projection (Body 1, spherical anchor). Four random starts per body, minimum finite measurement residual selection.
geometry_metric: Euclidean relative lever error; JT final sample and STEP Stage I estimate
timing_scope: Stage I separate; compiled Stage II / JT full-record calls include history allocation and parent reference construction; exclude compilation, scoring, archive I/O and periodic numerical diagnostics.
selection_rule: No tuning of covariance or trajectory against reference errors; numerical modifications justified by independent derivative checks.
data_model_scope: Synthetic two-angle link directions and endpoint point masses, regularized generalized acceleration solve. Not a full three-dimensional rigid-body rotational inertia model.
data_noise_choice: Noise and bias are added to the clean record (see configs/measurement_errors.json).
